import itertools
# regions of Venn: subsets of {N,S,C,R}; sets nonempty
names='NSCR'
regions=list(range(16))
def mem(r,x): return (r>>names.index(x))&1
import random
def holds(pop):
    have=lambda f:any(f(r) for r in pop)
    allf=lambda a,b:all((not mem(r,a)) or mem(r,b) for r in pop)
    def some(a,b): return have(lambda r:mem(r,a) and mem(r,b))
    def no(a,b): return not some(a,b)
    if not(allf('N','S') and some('S','C') and no('C','R')): return None
    if not all(any(mem(r,x) for r in pop) for x in names): return None
    return (no('S','R'),no('R','C'),some('S','N'))
res=[]
for mask in range(1,1<<16):
    pop=[r for r in range(16) if mask>>r&1]
    h=holds(pop)
    if h: res.append(h)
follow=tuple(all(h[i] for h in res) for i in range(3))
assert follow==(False,True,True)
opts={'A':(True,False,True),'B':(False,True,True),'C':(True,True,True),'D':(False,False,True)}
r=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v==follow]
assert r==['B']
